rules.description: Functions should not be empty
Dead stores should be removed
String literals should not be duplicated
Cognitive Complexity of functions should not be too high
Conditionals should start on new lines
Using pseudorandom number generators (PRNGs) is security-sensitive
Disabling CSRF protections is security-sensitive
Having a permissive Cross-Origin Resource Sharing policy is security-sensitive
Credentials should not be hard-coded
SQL queries should not be vulnerable to injection attacks
Endpoints should not be vulnerable to reflected cross-site scripting (XSS) attacks
Server certificates should be verified during SSL/TLS connections
Cryptographic keys should be robust
Setting loose POSIX file permissions is security-sensitive
Creating cookies without the "HttpOnly" flag is security-sensitive
Encrypting data is security-sensitive
Using command line arguments is security-sensitive
Expanding archive files without controlling resource consumption is security-sensitive
Track uses of "FIXME" tags
Track uses of "TODO" tags
Sections of code should not be commented out
Assignments should not be made from within sub-expressions
"switch" statements should not contain non-case labels
"switch" statements should have at least 3 "case" clauses
"try-catch" blocks should not be nested
Unused local variables should be removed
Local variables should not be declared and then immediately returned or thrown
Code should not be dynamically injected and executed
Array constructors should not be used
"return" and "yield" should not be used outside of functions
Generic exceptions should not be ignored
"NaN" should not be used in comparisons
Tests should include assertions
"export const" should be avoided
Object literal shorthand syntax should be used
"arguments" should not be accessed directly
"await" should only be used with promises
Function returns should not be invariant
Braces and parentheses should be used consistently with arrow functions
Literals should not be thrown
"trim" functions should not be used in a loop
"undefined" should not be assigned to variables
Loops should not be infinite
All branches in a conditional structure should not have exactly the same implementation
"await" should not be used in loops
Collection elements should not be replaced unconditionally
Empty collections should not be accessed or iterated
Type predicates should be used
Optional boolean parameters should have default value
"indexOf" checks should not be for positive numbers
Template strings should be used instead of concatenation
